content.comment_body: Is there a way to cancel, reset, or immediately clear the remaining time on an off delay timer? When sequencing motor starts using on/off delay timers, I want to be able to reset the off-delay time as soon as a contact changes state, for example during an emergency stop. Currently, I have to wait for the entire delay before an emergency reset can be performed, but I would prefer to zero the remaining time instead of waiting. I'm new to [product_name] programming and am still searching for a solution. Any advice or tips would be appreciated. Thanks!
Welcome to the forum. The off delay timer in [product_name] software includes a reset input. Please see the attached video for reference.

Thank you for the quick response! I should have reviewed that function before posting. Just for reference: the combined on/off delay function doesn’t seem to offer a reset input (at least I couldn’t find one). Thanks for the information—I'm updating my logic now to minimize waiting.
I can address the questions you specifically asked. You only mentioned needing information about the off delay, not about combined on/off delay timers.
For combined on/off delay timers, implementing a reset function when switching off requires some additional circuit logic.
